rule.title: Decoupled API Client Service Layer (No Fetch/Axios in JSX)
rule.statement: UI components must not call axios or fetch directly in JSX event handlers or useEffect hooks; all calls must be encapsulated in typed API service functions.
rule.rationale: Scattering HTTP client invocations across components makes global error handling, authentication interceptors, retry logic, and testing impossible.
rule.implementation_guidance: Export typed functions from features/<feature>/api/ (e.g. getDocuments(): Promise<Document[]>).

forbidden.example: const res = await axios.get('/api/v1/documents'); // Direct Axios call in button onClick handler

source.book_title: Learn React with TypeScript - Third Edition
source.chapter: Chapter 8: Client Data Fetching with TanStack Query and REST APIs
source.evidence_quote: Encapsulate HTTP requests in dedicated API modules. Components should consume strongly-typed functions rather than interacting with the network client directly.
